entries.aphasia: a-(without) + phas(to speak) + -ia(表示病名的字尾)
entries.asylum: a-(without) + syl(right of seizure) + -um(表示地點的字尾)
entries.atheism: a- (without) + the (god) + -ism (表示主義、學說的字尾)
entries.abaxial: ab-(away) + ax(axis 軸) + ial(形容詞字尾)
entries.abdicate: ab- (from) + dicate (to proclaim 發表宣言)
entries.abortion: ab- (away from) + or (to rise) + -tion (名詞字尾)
entries.acknowledge: ac- – ad-(to) + know(to know) + -ledge(名詞字尾)
entries.allay: al - ad (to) + lay(to cause to lie)
entries.approbate: ap- = ad- (to) + prob (to prove) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.arrogant: ar- = ad- (to) + rog (to ask) + -ant (形容詞字尾)
entries.assert: as- = ad- (to) + sert (to join or bind together)
entries.ambition: amb- = ambi- (about) + it (to go) + -(t)ion (名詞字尾)
entries.amphibian: amphi- (on both sides) + bio (life) + -an (形容詞字尾)
entries.antiseptic: anti-(against) + sept (putrid 腐爛的) + -ic (形容詞兼名詞字尾)
entries.antagonist: ant- = anti-(against) + agony(struggle) + -ist(表示人的字尾)
entries.autoinfection: auto- (self) + in (in) + fect (to act) + -ion (名詞字尾)
entries.beneficiary: bene- (well) + fic (to do) + -iary (表示人的字尾)
entries.benignant: beni-(well) + gn = gen (to produce) + -ant(形容詞字尾)
entries.bifurcated: bi-(two) + furcat(to fork 分叉) + -ed(形容詞字尾)
entries.circumpolar: circum- (around) + pol (axis of a sphere 球體的軸) + -ar (形容詞字尾)
entries.compatriot: com- (together) + patri (father) + -ot (表示人的名詞字尾)
entries.coalition: co- = com- (together) + alition = alesce (to grow up)
entries.cohabitation: co- = com- (together) + habit (to have) + -ation (名詞字尾)
entries.collusion: col- = com-(together) + lus(to play) + -ion(名詞字尾)
entries.combustion: comb- - com- (wholly) + ust(to burn) + -tion(名詞字尾)
entries.conglomerate: con- = com- (together) + glomer (ball of yarn 線團) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.contaminate: con- = com- (together) + tamin (to touch) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.corroborate: cor- = con- (wholly) + robor (robust 強壯的) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.detach: de- = dis-(opposite否定) + tach(to stake 拴)
entries.disable: dis-(to deprive of 剝谷) + able(capability)
entries.disconsolate: dis- (not) + consol (console 安慰) + -ate (形容詞字尾)
entries.disintegrate: dis- (not) + in- (not) + tegr (to touch) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.duplicate: du- = duo- (two) + plic (to fold) + -ate (形容詞字尾)
entries.duplicity: du- = duo- (two) + plic (to fold) + -ity (名詞字尾)
entries.eliminate: e- = ex- (out) + limin (threshold 門檻;界限) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.emaciate: e- = ex-(out) + maci(lean 瘦的) + -ate(動詞字尾)
entries.emanate: e = ex-(out) + man(to flow) + -ate(動詞字尾)
entries.erudite: e = ex-(out) + rud(crude 天然的) | .ite(形容詞字尾)
entries.evident: e = ex·(out) + vid(to see) + -ant(形容詞字尾)
entries.hypertrophy: hyper-(beyond) + troph (to nourish 滋養) + -y(名詞字尾)
entries.intricate: in- (in) + tric (obstacle 妨礙) + -ate (形容詞字尾)
entries.immanent: im- = in- (in) + man (to remain) + -ent (形容詞字尾)
entries.impeach: im- = in-(on,upon) + peach = pedic(fetter 腳鐐)
entries.impenetrate: im- = in- (into) + penetrate (to pierce 穿透)
entries.implement: im- = in- (in) + ple (to fill) + -ment (名詞字尾)
entries.imprecate: im- = in- (on, upon) + prec (to pray) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.irruption: ir- = in- (in) + rupt (to burst) + -ion (名詞字尾)
entries.ignominy: i- = in- (not) + nominy (something by which one is known 名聲)
entries.irreligious: ir- = in- (not) + religious (虔誠的;宗教的)
entries.enterprise: enter- = inter- (among) + prise (to take in hand)
entries.rical: iso-(equal) + metr = meter(to measure) + -ic(al)(形容詞字尾)
entries.malignant: mal- (badly) + gn = gen (to produce) + -ant (形容詞字尾)
entries.multiparous: multi-(many) + par(bo bear 生) + -ous(形容詞字尾)
entries.neuter: ne-(not) + uter(whether of the two 一者中任一)
entries.nonaggression: not-(not) + ag- = ad-(to) + gress(to walk) + -ion(名詞字尾)
entries.opponent: op- = ob- (against) + pon (to place) + -ent (形容詞字尾)
entries.ostentation: os- = ob- (before) + tent (to stretch) + -ation (名詞字尾)
entries.pantheism: pan- (all) + the (god) + -ism (表示主義的名詞字尾)
entries.polytheism: poly·(many) + the(god) + -ism(表示主義的名詞字尾)
entries.precocious: pre- (before) + coci (to cook; to ripen) + -ous (形容詞字尾)
entries.predecessor: pre-(before) + de (away) + cess(to go) + -or(表示人的名詞字尾)
entries.prominent: pro-(forth) + min(to jut 突出) + -ent(形容詞字尾)
entries.refrigerator: re- (again) + frigerate (to make cold) + -or (表示物品的名詞字尾)
entries.reminiscence: re-(again) + minisc(to remember) + ence(名詞字尾)
entries.resurrection: re- (again) + surrect = surgere (to rise) + -ion (名詞字尾)
entries.retaliate: re- (back) + tali (talion 報復) + -ate (動詞字尾)
entries.suffocate: suf. = sub-(under) + fec = fauc(gullet 咽喉) + -ate(動詞寫尾)
entries.system: sy- = syn- (together) + ste (to stand) + -m (名詞字尾 = -ment)
entries.syllepsis: s yl = syn-(together) + lep(to take) + -sis(名詞字尾)
entries.tradition: tra- - trans-(across) + dit(to give) + -ion(名詞字尾)
entries.traitor: 拉丁文 traditor = tra- (across) + dit (to give) + -or (表示人的名詞字尾)
entries.unconditional: un- (not) + conditional (有條件的;有約束的)
entries.undefined: un-(not) + define(下定義) + -(e)d(形容詞字尾)
entries.villain: 拉丁文 villa = 鄉下的房子
entries.heathen: heath = 石南屬的常綠灌木(茂盛的荒野)
entries.connoisseur: co- = com- (fully) + 拉丁文 noscere (to know)
entries.tutor: 拉丁文 tueri = to look after
entries.petroleum: 拉丁文 petra (岩石) + oleum (油)
entries.sanatorium: 拉丁文 sanare = to heal(治療)
entries.imponderable: im- = not, ponder = 深思,熟慮
entries.insolent: 拉丁文 in- = against + sol (to stretch) + -ent
entries.obstinate: 拉丁文 ob- (against) + stin (to cause to stand) + -ate
entries.obsolete: 拉丁文 ob- (against) + sol (to be accustomed) + -ete
entries.absolute: 拉丁文 ab (from) + solute = solvere (to loosen)
entries.accommodate: 拉丁文 accommodate = to fit, to adapt(使適應)
entries.navigate: 拉丁文 nav = navis(ship) + ig(to drive) + -ate
entries.originate: 拉丁文 origi = to rise, to begin
entries.stupefy: 拉丁文 stupēre = to be astonished
entries.blemish: 冰島文 blár = bluish(帶青色的)
entries.twinkle: 古英文 twinken = to wink(眨眼)
entries.exigent: ex- = out; ig = act = to act
entries.altruism: altru = alter (other) + -ism (表主義的名詞字尾)
entries.misanthrope: mis- = 希臘文 misein = to hate (憎恨)
entries.arms: 注意: 與手臂之意的 arm 字源不同
entries.armada: 西班牙文 armada = fleet (艦隊)
entries.auspice: au = avi(bird) + spice = 拉丁文 specere(to see)
entries.inaugurate: in-(in) + augurate - 拉 1 文 augurare(to augur 佔兆)
entries.carnivalesque: esque = in the manner of(以 - 風格)
entries.carnivore: vore = 拉丁文 vorare = to devour
entries.centrifugal: fugal = 拉丁文 fugere - to flee
entries.resuscitate: re (again) + sus-= sub (under) + cit (to call) + -ate(動詞字尾)
entries.solicit: soli = 拉丁文 sollus = whole entire
entries.affair: 古代法語 faire -拉丁文 facere
entries.flamboyant: 古代法語 flamboyer = to flame, 燃燒
entries.florist: ist 表示人的名詞字尾
entries.subject: sub- = under
entries.meteorology: meteor = 大氣中的現象;流星
entries.emancipate: e- = ex- = out; manu = hand; cip = to take
entries.renegade: re-(again) + neg(to deny) + -ade(表人的名詞字尾)
entries.pediatrician: iatr = healing; -ician 表人的名詞字尾
entries.pedophilia: pedo(child) - phil(to love) + -ia(表示病名的字尾)
entries.simple: sim-=拉丁文 singuli - one by one
entries.primordial: ordial - 拉丁文 ordial = to begin

entries.desperado: de to deprive of : -ado 表"人"

entries.venturesome: -some 形容詞字尾、表"具有一性質"
